title: Microsoft Copilot: publish organisation prompts to every user from the Microsoft 365 admin center
summary: The briefing passes: the publishing paths, directory-role assignment API, prerequisites and limits are supported by Microsoft documentation. The roadmap facts match the supplied record, and targeted searches confirmed the narrowly stated documentation gaps.
